Gyges Labs recently completed its Pre-A+ funding round, with investments from Granite Asia and Radiant Capital. Following the international success of its co-launched AI glasses, Halliday, the funding will primarily support the expansion of a more diverse range of "superhuman gear" (AI wearable products), with new products scheduled to debut starting in early 2026.

Unlike approaches that aim to replace humans with AI, Gyges Labs is an AI wearable technology company dedicated to "empowering everyone to become superhuman." The company operates globally, with its headquarters in Singapore, software and AI teams based in Silicon Valley, and leverages China's supply chain advantages, featuring unique technologies such as advanced optics and active AI.

Just as Iron Man and Batman's gear grants ordinary individuals superhuman abilities, Gyges Labs believes that applying AI to wearable products, enabling humans to harness AI, makes people more irreplaceable than directly providing AI with physical forms.

Luo Tingxia, founding partner of Radiant Capital, stated: "As a next-generation investment firm focused on technology and consumer sectors, we are committed to identifying and supporting companies that define the future. Gyges Labs perfectly embodies this vision. While the smart glasses industry is still exploring forms, they have strategically positioned themselves at the forefront of the next human-computer interaction interface with their forward-looking insights into 'invisibility' and 'proactivity' as core experiences. Their team demonstrates exceptional product definition capabilities and pragmatism.

Convertir a las personas en superhumanos podría ser el enfoque correcto para el paradigma de interacción humano-máquina. excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 17th, AI+ consumer robotics company Ling Universe announced the completion of a 200 million yuan Pre-A series funding round, with investors including Didi Chuxing, Lakala, Shanghai International, Guotai Haitong, and GF Xinde. This follows a previous funding round last year from backers such as 37 Interactive Entertainment, SenseTime, and Linear Capital.

Recently, at their office in Beijing's Wangjing district, we met with Ling Universe founder Gu Jiawei for an in-depth conversation. Gu's background includes roles as a Microsoft Research Asia researcher, "Baidu Young Leader," principal R&D architect at Baidu's Institute of Deep Learning, and MIT Technology Review's TR35 innovator. In 2016, he joined a listed A-share company as vice president and co-founded its subsidiary Wuling Technology, where he previously discussed his vision for "animating all things" in an interview with Leiphone. In 2023, Gu embarked on a new venture by founding Ling Universe to continue his entrepreneurial vision.

The new company, though small, is fully functional. In a conference room under 100 square meters, a prominent cartoon at the entrance depicts a future where robots serve tea, assist in childcare, and perform nearly all human-needed services. Gu stated this has been his goal since his first startup, but the timing was premature then. Now, with rapid advancements in large models, he believes the moment is right to pursue this vision.

Esta es otra ronda tras la inversión del año pasado de capitales como 37 Interactive Entertainment, SenseTime y Linear Capital. Hace poco, en nuestra oficina de Wangjing, Pekín, conocimos al fundador de Ling Universe, Gu Jiawei, y mantuvimos una conversación profunda con él. Exinvestigador de Microsoft Research Asia, "Joven Talento de Baidu", arquitecto jefe de desarrollo del Instituto de Aprendizaje Profundo de Baidu e innovador tecnológico del MIT TR35.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 18, Leiphone reported the launch of Zebra Oral, the world's first one-on-one AI tutor product for children aged 6–12. It features a "superhuman AI tutor" that provides personalized, full-English instruction, enabling every child to have a dedicated AI tutor. The release marks AI's transition from general exploration to practical application in specific industries, representing the first industrialized AI Agent in education. 

Parents often face challenges in children's oral language training, such as difficulty finding and scheduling human tutors, inconsistent expertise, and children's reluctance to speak. Zebra Oral addresses these issues with its superhuman AI tutor, leveraging advantages like exceptional memory and storage to recall every moment of a child's lessons—from speaking performance and knowledge accumulation to unique habits, interests, and personality traits. 

The breakthrough of a "leading AI tutor" stems from Zebra Oral's deep focus on the highly specific scenario of one-on-one children's oral practice. This requires the AI to possess multiple capabilities: first, speech recognition that understands children, deciphering non-standard accents, fragmented sentences, and jumping thoughts; second, teaching logic that effectively educates, supported by complex algorithms integrating second language acquisition theory, child cognitive psychology, and extensive teaching cases.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Leifeng News, el 18 de noviembre se lanzó oficialmente "Zebra Oral", el primer producto global de tutoría individual de IA para niños de 6 a 12 años. Destacado por su "tutor de IA sobrehumano", ofrece clases individuales completamente en inglés, permitiendo que cada niño tenga un tutor de IA personalizado. Su lanzamiento marca la transición de los modelos de IA de exploración general a aplicaciones específicas en sectores verticales, siendo el primer agente de IA verdaderamente industrializado en la educación. Con el nacimiento del "tutor sobrehumano", surge la pregunta: ¿funcionará el tutor de IA? En el aprendizaje oral infantil, los padres suelen enfrentar dificultades para encontrar y reservar tutores nativos reales, junto con la inconsistencia en su nivel profesional.

title_i18n.zh: 双子座3现已问世，谷歌称其将提升搜索智能化水平。
title_i18n.es: Gemini 3 ya está aquí, y Google afirma que hará que la búsqueda sea más inteligente.

excerpt_i18n.en: Gemini 3 is skilled at reasoning, generating video, and writing code. Amid talk of an AI bubble, Google notes the new model could help increase search revenue too.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Gemini 3擅长推理、生成视频和编写代码。在关于人工智能泡沫的讨论中，谷歌指出这款新模型还有助于提升搜索收入。
excerpt_i18n.es: Gemini 3 destaca en razonamiento, generación de vídeo y escritura de código. En medio de los rumores sobre una burbuja de la IA, Google señala que el nuevo modelo también podría ayudar a incrementar los ingresos por búsquedas.
